cards.scene_sentence: You're going out with the guy.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 你要和那个男的出去约会。
cards.everyday_example: She's been going out with him for a few months.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 她和他约会几个月了。

cards.scene_sentence: I don't want her to go through what I did with Carl.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我不想让她经历我和卡尔之间的遭遇。
cards.everyday_example: Nobody should have to go through that alone.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 没人应该独自承受那种事。

cards.scene_sentence: All of a sudden, the phone starts to ring.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 电话突然响了起来。
cards.everyday_example: All of a sudden, everyone went quiet.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 突然间，所有人都安静了。

cards.scene_sentence: And it turns out it's my mother.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 结果发现是我妈妈。
cards.everyday_example: The meeting turned out to be useful.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 结果这次会议很有用。

cards.scene_sentence: Carol moved her stuff out today.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 卡萝尔今天把她的东西搬走了。
cards.everyday_example: My roommate is moving out next week.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我的室友下周要搬出去。

cards.scene_sentence: Why does everyone keep fixating on that?
cards.scene_translation_zh: 为什么大家一直揪着那件事不放？
cards.everyday_example: Try not to fixate on one small mistake.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 别一直纠结一个小错误。

cards.scene_sentence: They took it pretty well.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 他们接受得还算平静。
cards.everyday_example: He didn't take the criticism very well.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 他没能很好地接受批评。

cards.scene_sentence: To hell with her.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 去她的。
cards.everyday_example: To hell with perfection; let's ship it.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 别管完美了，我们发布吧。

cards.definition_zh: 使某人产生性吸引或兴奋
cards.scene_sentence: I realized I was more turned on by this gravy boat than Barry.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我意识到这个调味汁壶比巴瑞更让我心动。
cards.everyday_example: Confidence can be a real turn-on.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 自信真的很有吸引力。

cards.scene_sentence: I got freaked out, and it hit me: How much Barry looks like Mr. Potato Head.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我吓坏了，然后突然意识到巴瑞很像土豆先生。
cards.everyday_example: Don't freak out; we still have time.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 别慌，我们还有时间。

cards.scene_sentence: I had to get out of there, and I started wondering.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我必须离开那里，然后我开始思考。
cards.everyday_example: The room felt unsafe, so we got out of there.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 那个房间让人觉得不安全，所以我们离开了。

cards.scene_sentence: I know we've drifted apart.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我知道我们渐渐疏远了。
cards.everyday_example: We drifted apart after graduation.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 毕业后我们逐渐疏远了。

cards.scene_sentence: I hoped that wouldn't be an issue.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我本希望那不会成为问题。
cards.everyday_example: Would the earlier start time be an issue?
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 提前开始会有问题吗？

cards.scene_sentence: If I let go of my hair, my head will fall off.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 如果我松开头发，我的脑袋就会掉下来。
cards.everyday_example: You need to let go of what you can't control.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 你需要放下无法控制的事。

cards.scene_sentence: Well, it matters to me!
cards.scene_translation_zh: 可这对我很重要！
cards.everyday_example: Your opinion matters to me.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 你的意见对我很重要。

cards.scene_sentence: I guess we've established she's staying with Monica.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 看来我们已经确定她要住在莫妮卡家。
cards.everyday_example: Let's establish the facts before deciding.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我们先查明事实再决定。

cards.scene_sentence: This is probably for the best.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 这或许是最好的结果。
cards.everyday_example: The delay may be for the best.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 这次延期或许反而是好事。

cards.scene_sentence: Me and Chandler live across the hall.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我和钱德勒住在走廊对面。
cards.everyday_example: The meeting room is across the hall.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 会议室就在走廊对面。

cards.scene_sentence: Stop hitting on her!
cards.scene_translation_zh: 别再撩她了！
cards.everyday_example: A stranger kept hitting on her at the bar.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 酒吧里有个陌生人一直搭讪她。

cards.scene_sentence: Buzz him in.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 按门禁让他进来。
cards.everyday_example: Can you buzz the delivery driver in?
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 你能按门禁让送货员进来吗？

cards.scene_sentence: He finally asked you out?
cards.scene_translation_zh: 他终于约你出去了？
cards.everyday_example: I finally worked up the courage to ask her out.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我终于鼓起勇气约她出去了。

cards.definition_zh: 值得写进日记的特别时刻
cards.scene_sentence: It's a "Dear Diary" moment.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 这是个值得写进日记的时刻。
cards.everyday_example: Getting the offer was a real Dear Diary moment.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 拿到录用通知真是个值得纪念的时刻。

cards.scene_sentence: I'll be right back.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我马上回来。
cards.everyday_example: Wait here; I'll be right back.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 在这儿等着，我马上回来。

cards.scene_sentence: I just pulled out four eyelashes.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我刚拔掉了四根睫毛。
cards.everyday_example: She pulled out a chair for me.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 她为我拉出一把椅子。

cards.scene_sentence: What are you up to tonight?
cards.scene_translation_zh: 你今晚有什么安排？
cards.everyday_example: What are you up to this weekend?
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 你这周末打算做什么？

cards.scene_sentence: I was supposed to be headed for Aruba on my honeymoon.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我本来应该去阿鲁巴度蜜月。
cards.everyday_example: We're headed for the airport now.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我们现在正前往机场。

cards.scene_sentence: But I'm just going to hang out here.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 不过我就打算待在这里。
cards.everyday_example: Do you want to hang out after work?
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 下班后想一起待会儿吗？

cards.scene_sentence: I see no worm guys whatsoever.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我完全没看到那些小虫子似的零件。
cards.everyday_example: There was no evidence whatsoever.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 完全没有任何证据。

cards.scene_sentence: Please don't spoil all this fun.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 请别破坏这些乐趣。
cards.everyday_example: Don't spoil the fun by telling us the ending.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 别剧透结局扫大家的兴。

cards.scene_sentence: You got screwed.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 你被坑惨了。
cards.everyday_example: We got screwed by the hidden fees.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我们被隐藏费用坑了。

cards.scene_sentence: My brother's going through that.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我哥哥也正在经历这种事。
cards.everyday_example: She's going through a difficult time.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 她正经历一段艰难时期。

cards.scene_sentence: How did you get over it?
cards.scene_translation_zh: 你是怎么走出来的？
cards.everyday_example: It took him months to get over the breakup.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 他花了几个月才从分手中走出来。

cards.scene_sentence: Steer clear of you.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 得离你远点。
cards.everyday_example: I'd steer clear of that website.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我会避开那个网站。

cards.scene_sentence: The machine cut me off again.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 答录机又把我的话截断了。
cards.everyday_example: Sorry to cut you off, but we're out of time.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 抱歉打断你，但我们没时间了。

cards.scene_sentence: After which she ripped your heart out.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 然后她让你伤透了心。
cards.everyday_example: That final scene ripped my heart out.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 最后那场戏让我心碎。

cards.scene_sentence: You wanna spell it out with noodles?
cards.scene_translation_zh: 你想用面条把它拼出来说明吗？
cards.everyday_example: Let me spell it out: we can't afford it.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我直说吧：我们负担不起。

cards.definition_zh: 出人意料的新发现或坦白
cards.scene_sentence: It's more of a fifth date kind of revelation.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 这更像是第五次约会才该透露的事。
cards.everyday_example: The report contained a surprising revelation.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 报告里有一个惊人的新发现。

cards.scene_sentence: Even if I could get it together enough to ask a woman out.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 就算我能振作到足以约一个女人出去。
cards.everyday_example: Get it together; the interview starts in five minutes.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 振作起来，面试五分钟后开始。

cards.scene_sentence: I think we're getting a little ahead of ourselves.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我觉得我们有点想得太早了。
cards.everyday_example: Let's not get ahead of ourselves before the results arrive.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 结果出来前我们别过早下结论。

cards.scene_sentence: Big time!
cards.scene_translation_zh: 非常严重！
cards.everyday_example: Did I mess up? Big time.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我搞砸了吗？非常严重。

cards.scene_sentence: I take credit for Paul.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 保罗这件事得算我的功劳。
cards.everyday_example: He took credit for the team's work.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 他把团队的功劳算在自己头上。

cards.term: put that out into the universe
cards.definition_zh: 把负面想法说出口并传递出去
cards.scene_sentence: You don't want to put that out into the universe.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 你不会想把这种负面念头说给宇宙听。
cards.everyday_example: I'm putting it out into the universe: I want that job.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我要把愿望说出来：我想得到那份工作。

cards.scene_sentence: I was laughed out of 12 interviews.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我在十二场面试中都被人笑了出来。
cards.everyday_example: They laughed him out of the room.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 他们嘲笑得他离开了房间。

cards.scene_sentence: You're surprisingly upbeat.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 你出乎意料地乐观。
cards.everyday_example: She stayed surprisingly upbeat after the rejection.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 被拒后她仍出乎意料地乐观。

cards.scene_sentence: You can't live off your parents.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 你不能靠父母养活。
cards.everyday_example: He lived off his savings for six months.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 他靠积蓄生活了六个月。

cards.scene_sentence: Give her a break.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 对她宽容点。
cards.everyday_example: Give me a break; it was my first attempt.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 饶了我吧，这只是我第一次尝试。

cards.scene_sentence: It's hard being on your own.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 独立生活很难。
cards.everyday_example: I learned to manage the project on my own.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我学会了独立管理这个项目。

cards.scene_sentence: I ended up living with this albino guy.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 最后我和一个白化病男人住在一起。
cards.everyday_example: We ended up taking the last train home.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 最后我们坐末班车回家了。

cards.scene_sentence: Kind of a symbolic gesture.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 算是一种象征性的举动。
cards.everyday_example: Planting the tree was a symbolic gesture.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 种下这棵树是一种象征性举动。

cards.scene_sentence: I think we can leave it at that.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我觉得就到这里吧。
cards.everyday_example: We've apologized, so let's leave it at that.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我们已经道歉了，就到此为止吧。
